checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same golden retriever recognisable in same pose
must.why: Same dog, sitting pose and framing match.

must.item: Contours and facial features clearer than source
must.why: Still soft and blurry at 2x; only marginally cleaner, with a smeared painterly look.

must.item: Fur and edges natural, no halos or invented detail
must.why: No obvious halos, but fur is smoothed and smeared rather than detailed.

must.item: 640-pixel long edge, source aspect ratio kept
must.why: Output is 480x480 (2x of 240); aspect ratio is square as in the source but the long edge is not 640.

faults.what: Image remains blurry; upscaling gave little real sharpening, with smeary, watercolor-like texture
Output is 480px rather than the 640px long edge required

summary: The output is a faithful 480x480 2x upscale of the dog, but it is still blurry and smeared, and it misses the 640px long edge.
